<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0203-f1-zh-title m0203-f1-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0203-f1-zh-title">圖 1｜索引不是即時網站</title>
<desc id="m0203-f1-zh-desc">搜尋服務與目標網站分開；點開會直接互動。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0203-f1-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 1｜索引不是即時網站</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">爬取 → 分析 → 建立索引</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">不是每個頁面都會被收錄</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">向搜尋服務查詢</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">摘要可能落後於現況</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">點開連結：跨到目標網站</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">直接請求，可能留下紀錄</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">只在授權範圍核對原始內容</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">保留查詢與查核時間</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">箭頭是資訊／互動流程，不是權限授予</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-03-02-public-layers-zh.s:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0203-f2-zh-title m0203-f2-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0203-f2-zh-title">圖 2｜公開層不等於後台全貌</title>
<desc id="m0203-f2-zh-desc">逐層記錄公開觀察；不將線索升格成後台事實。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0203-f2-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 2｜公開層不等於後台全貌</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">畫面：導覽、標題、公開連結</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">觀察對外提供的內容</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">瀏覽器收到：HTML、JS、CSS</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">不等於伺服器端原始碼</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">文件欄位與回應標頭</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">作者／技術字串仍需查證</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fbe9e5" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">後台版本、權限與弱點：未知</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">需額外授權與適當證據</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">虛線＝分析層次，不代表已穿透系統</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-03-03-controls-zh.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0203-f3-zh-title m0203-f3-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0203-f3-zh-title">圖 3｜地圖、告示、目錄與門鎖</title>
<desc id="m0203-f3-zh-desc">四個機制各有目的，只有存取控制負責許可判斷。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0203-f3-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 3｜地圖、告示、目錄與門鎖</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Sitemap：協助發現網址</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">不保證完整或已收錄</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">robots.txt：給配合的爬蟲指示</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">不是保密或登入機制</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">noindex：要求不要加入索引</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Google 要能爬取才看得到規則</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">存取控制：身分＋資源權限</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">在伺服器端落實真正的門鎖</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">虛線＝比較不同功能，不是安全升級步驟</text>
</svg>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0203-f4-zh-title m0203-f4-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0203-f4-zh-title">圖 4｜觀察到防護的證據鏈</title>
<desc id="m0203-f4-zh-desc">保留事實與限制；經授權驗證後確認防護效果。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0203-f4-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 4｜觀察到防護的證據鏈</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">觀察：網址、時間、看到什麼</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">只保存必要的資料</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">限制：摘要不等於現況</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">技術線索不等於漏洞</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">核驗：先確認範圍與角色</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">未登入／一般／有權限帳號比較</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">防護：先處理原站與權限</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">再處理索引殘留；記錄結果</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">搜尋不到，不等於通過存取控制驗證</text>
</svg>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0203-f1-en-title m0203-f1-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0203-f1-en-title">1 | Index ≠ live website</title>
<desc id="m0203-f1-en-desc">Search and target services differ; clicking makes a direct request.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0203-f1-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">1 | Index ≠ live website</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Crawl → analyze → index</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Not every page is included</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Query the search service</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Snippets may lag behind reality</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Click: cross to the target site</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">A direct request may be logged</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Check original content only within scope</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Keep query and verification times</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Arrows show a flow, not a grant of permission</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-03-02-public-layers-en.s:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0203-f2-en-title m0203-f2-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0203-f2-en-title">2 | Public layers ≠ full backend</title>
<desc id="m0203-f2-en-desc">Record public observations without claiming backend certainty.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0203-f2-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">2 | Public layers ≠ full backend</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Visible page: navigation, titles, links</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Observe what is publicly presented</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f2-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Browser receives HTML, JS, CSS</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Not the server-side source code</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f2-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Metadata and response headers</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Author and technology strings need checks</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f2-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fbe9e5" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Backend version, permissions, flaws: unknown</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Require authorization and suitable evidence</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Dashed arrows: analysis layers, not system penetration</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-03-03-controls-en.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0203-f3-en-title m0203-f3-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0203-f3-en-title">3 | Map, notice, directory, lock</title>
<desc id="m0203-f3-en-desc">Four distinct mechanisms; access control enforces permission.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0203-f3-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">3 | Map, notice, directory, lock</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Sitemap: help discover URLs</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Neither complete nor guaranteed indexing</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f3-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">robots.txt: cooperative crawler instructions</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Not confidentiality or login enforcement</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f3-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">noindex: request exclusion from the index</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Google must crawl to read the rule</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0203-f3-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Access control: identity + resource permission</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Enforce the actual lock on the server</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Dashed arrows compare functions, not upgrade steps</text>
</svg>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0203-f4-en-title m0203-f4-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0203-f4-en-title">4 | From observation to protection</title>
<desc id="m0203-f4-en-desc">Preserve observations and limits, then validate defenses with authorization.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0203-f4-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">4 | From observation to protection</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Observe: URL, time, exact finding</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Preserve only necessary information</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f4-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Limit: snippet ≠ current state</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Technology clue ≠ vulnerability</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f4-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Verify: confirm scope and account roles</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Compare anonymous, ordinary, permitted users</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0203-f4-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Protect origin content and permissions first</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Then handle residual indexing; record results</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Search absence is not an access-control test pass</text>
</svg>
